data.name: Kailash
data.gender_notes: Kailash is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A mountain (Kailash); crystal; abode of Shiva
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kailāsa, the sacred mountain, from the root kel, 'to be crystal'. Its root is Sanskrit kailāsa (कैलास). Mount Kailash, the abode of Shiva. Kailash is a Sanskrit name meaning “A mountain (Kailash); crystal; abode of Shiva”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kailash expresses “A mountain (Kailash); crystal; abode of Shiva”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kailāsa, the sacred mountain, from the root kel, 'to be crystal'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kailash total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
